messages:
Hannah (Recruiter): Sam accepted L4 yesterday. He asked if we can start 2026-04-22 instead of 2026-05-06 because his temporary housing ends early.
Devon (Hiring Manager): Team can shift. He asked if we can advance part of the $8k sign-on to help with moving and commute. Thoughts?
Morgan (People Ops): Options: frontload 50% sign-on (comp exception + amendment) or issue a one-off "commute assistance" stipend. Frontload changes payroll schedule.
Hannah (Recruiter): Candidate prefers frontload. He can sign an amendment today.
PeopleOps-Bot: New request REQ-2026-9981 created: "Frontload sign-on for early commute/relocation". Routing: Comp -> Legal -> Payroll. Standard SLA 3bd.
Rhea (Comp): Need manager justification and confirmation base unchanged. If provided I can fast-track to chair for one-off 50% approval.
Legal (Sanjay): No legal blockers. Amendment should include payment timing and clawback under 90 days. I can draft template.
Payroll Bot: To process $4,000 on 2026-04-22 run we need PR# and signed amendment by 2026-04-15 12:00 PT. Otherwise next run 05/01.
Benefits-Bot: Note: benefits eligibility unaffected by sign-on payout. Enrollment still per standard rules.
Devon (Hiring Manager): Manager note attached: "candidate moving window; high retention risk; critical infra hire."
Hannah (Recruiter): Candidate signed amendment and acknowledged clawback. Attaching signed doc.
Rhea (Comp): Approved 50% frontload under "early relocation/commute assistance". Chair sign-off attached.
Legal (Sanjay): AMEND-990 posted. Includes payment schedule and clawback.
Payroll Bot: PR#990-FL received. Scheduling $4,000 on 2026-04-22 and remainder on 2026-07-01.
Morgan (People Ops): Updated start date to 2026-04-22 in HRIS and logged exception. Closing REQ-2026-9981.
Hannah (Recruiter): Sam confirmed start and grateful. Thanks team! :tada:
